name: Glow Button
description: Rounded button that emits a soft glowing light streak racing around its border on hover or focus, built from two animated SVG rects.
contents: SVG glow outline with blurred layer and sharp line layer
behavior: On hover or focus a glow line travels around the border and fades in and out
Corner radius is read from the computed style and applied to the SVG rects
editableByProps: Label, colors, glow thickness, length, blur and speed, corner radius, click handler

needsCodeEdit.where: text-[clamp(1.25rem,5vw,2rem)] class on the glow-btn button
glow-rect rule in the style block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
